metadata.description: Yobiru agent messaging plugin (tailmsg protocol v1) for Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot.

plugins.name: yobiru
plugins.description: Peer-to-peer messages, file handoff and receiver-controlled wake-ups between AI agents on your own Tailscale network; private messaging speaks the tailmsg protocol v1 with no central server. Includes an unreleased development version of public bots and Friends through a gateway you host.
